name: screen
description: The real desktop, not a web page. Desktop apps as elements: screen_apps or screen_launch, screen_snapshot (each element with a ref), screen_act on a ref, screen_wait; windows with screen_windows and screen_window, the clipboard with screen_clipboard. Prefer that to pixels. For anything else, screen_ocr (words with their x,y) or screen_shot (the picture), then click, type and press keys at pixel x,y from the top-left. Web pages go through the chrome MCP.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|open the editor and write hello -> discover(path='mcp/screen', enable=true); screen_launch(command='mousepad'); screen_snapshot(app='mousepad'); screen_act(ref='3f2a:e12', action='type', value='hello')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|press Save in that dialog -> screen_find(app='mousepad', text='Save', role='push button'); screen_act(ref='3f2a:e4', action='click')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|what is on the screen -> discover(path='mcp/screen', enable=true); screen_shot()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|click the OK button -> screen_ocr(); screen_click(x=<x of OK>, y=<y of OK>)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|move the mouse like a person to the checkbox -> screen_cursor_move_human(x=420, y=310)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|type hello and press enter -> screen_type(text='hello'); screen_key(key='Return')
